info.title: GitHub REST API - public repository lookup (subset)
info.description: A subset of GitHub's public REST API (https://docs.github.com/rest/repos/repos#get-a-repository), written by the business owner to expose exactly one read operation. Unauthenticated calls return public repositories only and are rate-limited by GitHub.

get.description: Returns public facts about one repository: names, description, stars, forks, open issues and default branch.

parameters.name: owner
parameters.description: The account owner of the repository (not case sensitive)

parameters.name: repo
parameters.description: The name of the repository without the .git extension (not case sensitive)

404.description: Resource not found (also returned for private repositories without access)
